name: Nova Roma

categories.label: Sailing routes
categories.hint: VP of the furthest Port/Harbor each of your 2 ships reached; sum both ships.

categories.label: Building contracts
categories.hint: Total VP printed on your Building Contracts.

categories.label: Building zone: first zone
categories.hint: Read VP for your rank (most blocks = highest, 2nd = next, others with 1+ block = lowest) from below the zone on the map. Ties give full points.

categories.label: Building zone: second zone
categories.hint: Same rule, VP chart printed under this zone.

categories.label: Building zone: third zone
categories.hint: Same rule, VP chart printed under this zone.

categories.label: Chariot tokens
categories.hint: 3 VP per Favored Chariot token won.

categories.label: Hippodrome finishes
categories.hint: 5 VP per token that reached the final space of a Hippodrome track.

categories.label: End-game follower cards
categories.hint: VP from End Game Follower cards above your estate board (card-specific).

categories.label: Animal estate tiles
categories.hint: Sets: 1/2/3 tiles = 2/5/9 VP; split extras into multiple sets. Enter total VP.

categories.label: Mosaic board
categories.hint: Top row achievements 2 VP, middle 3, bottom 5, plus row/column/diagonal bonuses printed on board.

categories.label: Goods and coins (4:1)
categories.hint: Remaining goods + coins, divided by 4 rounded down.

categories.label: Influence and artisans (2:1)
categories.hint: Remaining influence + artisans, divided by 2 rounded down.

categories.label: First player token
categories.hint: 2 VP if you hold the first player token.

categories.label: Remaining influence (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Ảnh hưởng còn lại (phân định hòa)

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, the youngest player wins.

notes: family: area-majority. Score marked on track. Zone VP amounts are printed on the map (not in rulebook text), so zone rows are number inputs; tied players get full points for the position, 2-player game counts neutral blocks. Solo mode vs AI and 2-player neutral rules not modelled. Followers' end-game VP are card-specific (e.g. per Wood/Wine left, per Estate tile, 4 VP threshold cards) and entered as one number.

sources.title: Nova Roma rulebook (Queen Games, English)
sources.section: End Game p.15-16; Follower card index
